messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED · sev=2 · inference-canary / encoder-service
incident-bot: Symptoms: repeated CrashLoopBackOff on canary pods, burst of 5xx in prod-canary, HPA scaled to 0 then spiked, customer latency up for a subset of requests.
PagerDuty: paging Maya (oncall) — escalation: latency spike for canary + pod restarts (rule: inference-canary-error).
Maya: I'm on it. Watching logs and metrics now. @Tony can you join for infra?
Tony: joining. first look: canary pods show OOMKilled in container logs repeatedly, crash backoff. k8s events show kubelet eviction pressure on nodes hosting canaries.
Elaine: Deploy history: encoder-v2 feature flag rolled to 10% at 14:02 UTC via rollout service, canary subset got model/param bump.
Maya: customer impact? Carol?
Carol: We have a couple customers seeing higher error rates (~7% 5xx) for embeddings endpoint routed to canary. Not-wide but notable for a few paid tenants.
Tony: hypothesis: new encoder variant has higher RSS; HPA minReplicas=0 for canary pool caused aggressive cold start + OOM cascade when burst traffic arrives. Also nodeAffinity change moved canaries to a packed node group with lower memory.
Maya: okay kill-switch the flag to stop new canary traffic. Elaine can you flip feature flag to off and pause rollout?
Elaine: triggering flag rollback now via internal flag service:
Elaine: ```
POST https://flags.internal/flags/encoder_v2/toggle
{ "enabled": false, "env": "prod", "target": "canary" }
```
deploy-bot: rollout pause acknowledged for encoder-v2 at 14:10:23 UTC.
Elaine: flag toggled -> traffic should stop diverting within ~30s. Confirming.
Maya: while traffic drains, we should scale canary pool up a bit to let pods stabilize and avoid thundering herd. Tony set temp scaling?
Tony: bumping canary deployment replicas from 1->3 and setting HPA minReplicas=2 for canary pool to avoid scale-to-zero. Applying:
Tony: ```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment encoder-canary --replicas=3
kubectl -n inference patch hpa encoder-canary -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'
```
Tony: applied. Monitoring pod restarts.
Maya: node-level action? Should we cordon the memory-starved nodes and migrate canaries?
Tony: cordoning oldest node that was under memory pressure and evicting canary pods to balance:
Tony: ```
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-5-12.us-west-2.compute.internal
kubectl drain ip-10-0-5-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Tony: drain in progress, kube will reschedule pods onto nodes with available memory.
Elaine: deploy-bot logs show previous canary replica had image: encoder:v2.1. There was also an affinity change in the new manifest: preferredDuringScheduling became requiredDuringScheduling for nodeGroup=packed-gpu. That probably concentrated canaries.
Maya: good catch. We should revert the affinity change in the canary manifest after we stabilise. Elaine, plan a rollback of canary manifest after we validate flag off and nodes drained.
Elaine: plan: 1) flag off (done) 2) scale/hpa adjustments (done) 3) revert affinity/manifest change and redeploy canary to stable manifest 4) keep canary traffic paused until we confirm memory profile. I'll prepare a quick manifest revert.
Carol: customers now reporting success rates improving but still some residual 5xx. Numbers trending down.
Tony: Pod logs show fewer OOMs after scale and cordon, one recent crash shows stack: "std::bad_alloc" inside encoder process — looks like memory footprint exceeded container limit. We'll also raise container memory limit for canary temporarily.
Tony: ```
kubectl patch deployment encoder-canary -n inference -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"encoder","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"6Gi"},"requests":{"memory":"4Gi"}}}]}}}}'
```
Tony: patched. New pods coming up with higher memory limit.
Maya: good. Keep an eye on node utilization and HPA behavior. Set pager to continue if error rate >3% for 5m.
PagerDuty: alert rule updated by Maya.
Elaine: reverted affinity change and rolled canary manifest back to stable commit sha: a1b2c3d. Redeploying canary now with image encoder:v2.0-stable.
deploy-bot: rollout of encoder-canary to stable manifest started (rollout id 5481).
Maya: timebox: 30 minutes to confirm stability, then decide on gradual re-roll or abandon. Anyone seeing any other downstream issues?
Carol: Affected customers contacted with a note about degraded performance for a small subset; support ticket triage ongoing.
Tony: monitoring: node memory pressure cleared, OOM rate back to baseline. HPA settled at 2 replicas.
Maya: thumbs up. I'll keep this thread as the incident coordination. If anything regresses, re-page. After 30m, we'll make a post-incident note and link the playbook steps.
Elaine: capturing steps in the rollout runbook and will open postmortem ticket.
Maya: closing operational actions for now. Thanks team :thumbsup:
